title: Pediatric Heart Surgeries
summary: On 25th October, two pediatric heart surgeries were successfully completed through the efforts of Rotary Club of Mumbai Versova.
description: On 25th October, two pediatric heart surgeries were successfully completed through the efforts of Rotary Club of Mumbai Versova. A cheque of ₹1 lakh was handed over to Wadia Hospital towards this noble initiative. Heartfelt thanks to the anonymous donor for supporting this life-saving cause and bringing hope to young hearts
